FIELDS.NAME: Comfort Zone Heating & Refrigeration Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Comfort Zone Heating & Refrigeration Services specializes in providing reliable heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) solutions for residential and small commercial clients. Our operations include installation, maintenance, and repair services aimed at ensuring optimal indoor comfort throughout the year. We pride ourselves on our commitment to safety and compliance, employing only certified and licensed technicians with ongoing training in HVAC systems. Our services are backed by comprehensive written safety protocols and preventive maintenance programs that help minimize emergency service calls and extend equipment lifespan. We are dedicated to environmentally responsible practices, conforming to EPA Section 608 refrigerant handling requirements and conducting regular audits to ensure compliance. Furthermore, we maintain strong supplier relationships to guarantee timely access to high-quality HVAC parts, ensuring our clients experience minimal downtime.

Our company specializes in providing installation, maintenance, and service for ammonia-based refrigeration systems used in various industrial applications, ensuring efficiency and compliance with safety standards.
